title: observability: add token-level KV/cache metrics + tracing dashboards and alert tuning
author: Ava Martinez
description:
Motivation: Improve visibility into token-level cost and latency for cached KV-backed serving paths and add tracing hooks so SRE and product teams can detect regressions in cache effectiveness and tail latency. This PR adds new Prometheus metrics, OpenTelemetry spans for KV cache hits/misses/evictions, a Grafana dashboard (token-level cost/latency + KV cache heatmaps), and tuned alerting to reduce noisy alerts while preserving SLO coverage. Context: ENG-2384 requested end-to-end observability forDedicated/Private variants where KV caching has the biggest cost impact. Summary of changes and goals (single string): - Add token_kv_cache_hits_total, token_kv_cache_misses_total, token_kv_cache_evictions_total with labels (model, deployment, route, quantization_profile) - Add token_latency_by_cache{hit/miss} histogram to separate cached vs uncached token latency - Export token-level cost estimate metric token_cost_estimate_tokens with a per-token microcost (used for cost dashboards) - Instrument KV code path to create OpenTelemetry spans on cache lookup and backend fallback; add attributes for cache_key, shard, and hit_reason - Grafana: new dashboard panels for token cost breakdown, per-model cache hit heatmap, trace sample panel linked to Jaeger traces - Alerts: reduce alert noise by moving from per-deployment immediate paging to aggregated rate-based alerts for TTLs, eviction spikes, and sustained drop in cache hit-rate - Add migration guide for Private installer (extra env vars + OTEL collector config) Implementation notes: - Metrics use reduced label cardinality for cost-bearing labels; model label uses short model-id not full revision SHA - Histograms use exponential buckets tuned from production percentiles - Tracing creates lightweight spans (no sampling changes by default) Checklist: - [x] Metrics added and registered in metrics registry
- [x] Traces generated and tested with local Jaeger collector
- [x] Grafana dashboard JSON and template variables included
- [x] CI: unit tests and integration test mocks updated
- [x] Release notes drafted and QA run on staging
- [x] Migration docs added for Private install
How to validate locally: 1) Run local dev image with REDWOOD_OTEL_EXPORTER=jaeger and trigger demo requests in perf-canary harness (link: https://linear.app/redwood/ENG-2384). 2) Use ./tools/observe.sh --dashboard to load the dashboard and verify panels populate. 3) Run the included integ test redwood/integration/kv_cache_observability_test.go. Rollout plan: feature-flagged metrics (feature.observability.kv_token_metrics) enabled for 10% traffic on dedicated, monitor for alert noise for 48 hours, then 100% if stable.

review_comments: Daniel Kim (reviewer): Can we reduce label cardinality on model to short ids? Large cardinals will blow up TSDB. Suggested using model_short and adding model_rev only in trace attributes.
Ava Martinez (author): Agreed, switched model -> model_short for metrics, kept full model_rev in trace attributes. Updated histogram buckets after replaying 24h of production traces.
Priya Singh (reviewer): Alert tuning looks better but I'm worried about eviction spikes causing silent cost increases. Can we add a 1h aggregated alert for sustained eviction rate increases?
Ava Martinez (author): Added aggregated alert token_kv_eviction_rate_high_1h with runbook. Also added dashboard panel with 1h and 6h windows.
Liam O'Connor (SRE): Integration tests flaked on CI (race in test harness) — I pushed a small change to test to wait for prometheus scrape. Re-ran CI and all checks passed.
Daniel Kim (approver): LGTM after fixing test race and reducing model label cardinality. Approving and recommending squash merge.
Ava Martinez (author): Thanks — squashed commits and updated release notes per feedback.
ci_checks: integration-tests: failed (flake) on first run, fixed test race, re-run: pass
merge_details: Merged on 2026-02-28 via squash and merge by Daniel Kim. Merge commit: 'squash: observability: add token-level KV metrics, tracing, dashboard and alerts'
release_notes:
- Observability: Add token-level KV cache metrics, token latency histograms separated by cache hit/miss, tracing hooks for cache lookups, Grafana dashboard, and tuned alerting rules.
- Migration: Private installer requires updated OTEL collector config; see docs/migrations/private-kv-observability.md.
- Rollout: feature flag feature.observability.kv_token_metrics initially enabled for 10% of traffic.
testing_and_qa: Staging smoke: dashboard panels populated with perf-canary test data; integration test redwood/integration/kv_cache_observability_test.go added and passing in CI. Manual QA by SRE team verified trace linking to Jaeger samples.
notes: Kept metrics label set intentionally small. If we see high TSDB cardinality after rollout we'll add a trim/aggregation pipeline. Follow-up work (ENG-2401) to export summarized cost metrics to long-term metrics store.
